content:
Apple's all-new smart home hub, commonly referred to as the "HomePad," is reportedly set to launch on October 13. The latest leak has revealed the potential colorways it may come in.

The HomePad colors may include Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink

Last night, leaker pdfu posted images of what appears to be the HomePad setup process. This isn't pdfu's first leak — he previously revealed new features for the iPhone Duo, which are also expected to extend to the HomePad.

In a follow-up post, pdfu stated that the HomePad may come in four color options:

  • Silver
  • Space Gray
  • Starlight
  • Rose Pink

As shown in the images below, the HomePad setup process appears to default to specific preview graphics based on the colorway of the model being used.

According to earlier reports, the HomePad will offer watchOS-style face customization, allowing users to configure it as they wish.

The images found by pdfu showcase Apple's "Photo Face" feature on this all-new smart home hub and offer a glimpse of the upcoming square-shaped design.

What are your thoughts on the rumored HomePad colorways? Let us know in the comments.
